function.title: Trochlear nerve (CN IV) · draft
function.body: The trochlear nerve supplies the superior oblique muscle of the eye. It emerges from the dorsal brainstem and reaches the orbit through the superior orbital fissure.
function.note: The displayed source segment is not a validated reconstruction of the entire nerve course.
